narrative.intro: Salus Worldwide Solutions has $518M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Salus Worldwide Solutions received 2 awards with an average award size of $259M. Obligations are up 178.5% year over year. Fiscal-year detail shows no obligations from FY21 through FY24, $186M in FY25, and $518M in FY26. The company’s work is concentrated in air-transportation-related markets: Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation accounts for $512M and Other Support Activities for Air Transportation accounts for $5.7M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. The company’s award count and large average award size indicate a small number of high-value contracts driving the current-obligation total. Contractors and procurement officers evaluating Salus Worldwide Solutions should note the heavy reliance on a narrow set of NAICS markets and the recent jump in obligations compared with prior years.
